notes.title: First Patch released!
notes.content:
Good news, the first Cornerstone patch has been released!

This patch fixes many annoying bugs players have encountered and adds some new features!

Changelog v. 3.1.7: 

added V-sync in settings
added automatic control mode recognition
added feature: press Esc to skip each cutscene except the opening
Himalu ghost appears after Zemitara is defeated
corralled Ju-Long so that he doesn't teleport off the battlefield
Ju-Long now breaks oil barrels when he rushes, too, not just when he walks
fixed case where controller kept moving things left
fixed boat travel glitches when transitioning to another island
fixed Tyrim getting stuck between rocks and in chests
fixed Sven and sheep quest glitches
fixed Tyrim's sisters quest behavior
fixed fish taco book spawn issues in Rockwell
fixed windsurfer with sled could flip out after going into water
fixed case where windsurfer could dislodge Tyrim while moving
fixed killing the ghost in Himalu maze jail not being recognized
adjusted crystal event trigger in Rockwell to prevent Tyrim from falling
adjusted lever behavior in Rockwell overworld to raise and lower rocks, not just raise
adjusted raft spawning point indicator to better inform crafting position
various other fixes and adjustments
